p01.speaker: neha
p01.text: Every month, lenders send the same reminder, at the same time, to everyone.

p02.speaker: neha
p02.text: Kairos looks at every borrower, every day, and decides.

p03.speaker: neha
p03.text: Before anything goes out, Aladdin, our safety supervisor, checks it against the lender's rules.

p04.speaker: neha
p04.text: No reply on SMS. So it learns, and tries WhatsApp.

p06.speaker: neha
p06.text: But even they can't break the rules.

p07.speaker: neha
p07.text: Kairos answers in seconds. But only once it knows it's really them.

p08.speaker: neha
p08.text: A doctored payment screenshot? It checks with the bank.

p10.speaker: neha
p10.text: In our tests, about twice the money back for every rupee. With zero rule breaches.

t01.speaker: neha
t01.text: This is what happens inside Kairos, for one borrower, on one day.

t02.speaker: neha
t02.text: Everything starts from one record: loans, payments, replies and consent. Money to the paisa.

t03.speaker: neha
t03.text: Each day, a Bayesian learner scores every channel and hour, per segment and per borrower.

t04.speaker: neha
t04.text: Models only suggest. Aladdin reserves the budget and limits, then checks every rule again at send time.

t05.speaker: neha
t05.text: Messages go out through each channel. Delivery and replies come back as webhooks, and duplicates are ignored.

t06.speaker: neha
t06.text: Replies climb a ladder: rules first, then a small model. Thresholds are hand-set, and when it's unsure, it hands off to a person.

t07.speaker: neha
t07.text: People can step in at any moment. Every action still passes Aladdin, and lands in the audit log.

t08.speaker: neha
t08.text: Every outcome feeds the learner. Same data in, same decisions out.

t09.speaker: neha
t09.text: We attack it, load it, and test it.
